name: Noam Moshe
biography: Noam Moshe is a vulnerability researcher and Team Lead at Claroty Team82. Noam specializes in vulnerability research, web applications pentesting, malware analysis, network forensics and ICS/SCADA security. In addition, Noam presented in well-known Hacking conferences like Blackhat/Defcon, as well as won Master of Pwn at Pwn2Own Miami 2023
